_about: Rendered unit banners (render kit: _work/art/kit). One entry per rendered unit; alt describes the rendered picture. apply_banners.py only swaps a unit whose img/banners/<id>-1600.webp exists. Leave alt out to reuse the old SVG's aria-label. pencil_alt describes the pencil drawing (apply_banners.py --style pencil; drawings made by _work/art/pencil/pencil.py).
